resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two lookouts share the name Sheep Hill. The Clearwater lookout in this record is gone. The Nez Perce National Forest lookout at 8,405 feet is staffed and on the National Historic Lookout Register. Keep them apart.

sources.title: Clearwater National Forest Lookouts (list compiled by Margaret Sand and Cindy Schacher, June 2016)
Sheep Hill Lookout (Nez Perce National Forest)

notes_for_editor: The gone status agrees across firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts, the Clearwater National Forest list and the Forest Fire Lookout Association index. No source gives staffing, a removal date or the site's condition today, so the story omits staffing and says nothing is described. Do not confuse this with the standing, staffed Sheep Hill in the Nez Perce National Forest. The record's county 'Idaho' matches the index. The Clearwater list gives a location as Sec23 T33N R8E, which was not used.
